how_to_apply: Submit the application form by 24.11.2026 (last date for form submission). The form is filled online on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal: Apply online for KV No.1 AFS Jorhat Recruitment 2026.

On the portal, register (or log in with your mobile number and password), fill your personal details, choose the Jorhat school and the post, add your qualifications and experience, and upload your photo, PAN, Aadhaar and required certificates.
Review all details, accept the declaration, submit the form and save your application number / submission code. Log in again to check your application status on the dashboard.
Report at the Vidyalaya premises on 26.11.2026 from 09:00 AM for the walk-in interview.
Bring the duly filled application form (a printout of the form filled online), all original educational/professional certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies.
important_instructions: No TA/DA shall be admissible for attending the interview
